notes: 2022 and 2024: the Statement of Votes Cast workbook (headed 'Certified Final Results'), a sheet per contest, of which each sheet's Contest Total row is read (precincts with few voters print '***'). 2020: the Statement of Vote as a comma-separated file, one row per precinct, contest and candidate (read: precinct, contest, candidate, its type, party and total votes), added up here to the county. Ranked-choice contests (Albany, Berkeley, Oakland, San Leandro) are printed as first choices. Linked from https://acvote.alamedacountyca.gov/election-information/elections?id=252.

A zip of one old-format Excel file per contest, precinct by precinct (each precinct's polling place, vote-by-mail and total rows; the total rows are read). The county prints contest titles and names in short capital forms, kept as printed. Each file prints 'VOTE FOR: n' above its columns only where more than one is elected (2024's files print the number for every contest), so a file without it is read as electing one. Read with this loader's own reader for old-format Excel files (BIFF5 and BIFF8). Linked from https://www.lavote.gov/home/voting-elections/current-elections/election-results/past-election-results.

One row per precinct, contest and choice (tab-separated in 2022 and 2024, comma-separated in 2020). Read: precinct, contest title, choice, choice party and total votes. 'Unassigned write-ins' and 'Rejected write-ins' are not votes for a candidate and are not stored. Linked from https://ocvote.gov/data/election-results-archives/archived-statement-of-votes.

The results page's Excel version of its summary, headed 'Final Certified Election Results' on the page: every contest with '(Vote for n)', each choice's party where printed and its countywide total. 'Unresolved Write-In' lines are not votes for a candidate and are not stored. Linked from https://results.rov.sbcounty.gov/Results/20241105/.

A workbook with one sheet per contest (its Precinct Canvass), precinct by precinct; precincts with few voters print '***' ("vote data was suppressed due to voter privacy settings"), so only each sheet's Contest Total row is stored, as the county's figure. Party labels print in front of names ('DEM - '); measures print the share needed to pass. Linked from https://www.sdvote.com/content/rov/en/past-election-info.html.

The certified county figures, one row per county, contest and candidate, as linked from https://www.sos.ca.gov/elections/prior-elections/statewide-election-results/general-election-nov-5-2024/statement-vote. Read: county, contest, candidate, write-in flag, party and votes.
The certified county figures for every proposition, as linked from https://www.sos.ca.gov/elections/prior-elections/statewide-election-results/general-election-nov-5-2024/statement-vote.

The Statement's own pages for each office (workbooks): 16-president.xlsx, 19-uss-ft.xlsx, 22-uss-pt.xlsx, 25-us-rep-congress.xlsx, 37-state-senator.xlsx, 42-state-assembly.xlsx, 59-state-ballot-measures.xlsx, each at https://elections.cdn.sos.ca.gov/sov/2024-general/sov/<name>. Their State Totals and District Totals rows are the control totals.
